title: Open cloze exercise
description: One of four lexical exercises for one stored LexicalSense. A response may fill multiple word-level gaps and provide multiple grammar observations; the FSRS unit remains the LexicalSense shared by all four exercises.

exercise_id.description: Stable identity of this exercise content, unique across the generated batch and separate from a presentation identity.

lexical_sense_id.description: ID of the persisted LexicalSense practiced by this exercise. All four exercises in the set share this ID; an FSRS result belongs to the LexicalSense, not to each exercise or gap.

prompt.description: Ordered text and gap parts forming the complete sentence or short dialogue. Gap parts may be adjacent or separated by text. Every declared gap_id must occur exactly once.

hints.description: All hints visible to the learner before answering, in display order. Use an empty array when there are none. A hint may identify the lexical base or constrain an incidental decision but must not reveal the target form.

intent.description: Purpose of this exercise. Interpret grammar observations in light of the task purpose and any hints.

difficulty.description: Relative difficulty for this learner at generation time, based on the supplied profile, task context and hints; not the taxonomy variant's CEFR reference level.

gaps.description: IDs for individual word-level gaps. Each word the learner must supply has its own gap, including adjacent words in a multiword expression.

answer_keys.description: Map accepted answer-key IDs to complete responses. Each response must provide exactly one word for every declared gap and no other fragments. These IDs are the accepted_answer_key values used by the profile update contract.

additionalProperties.description: May contain multiple independently justified grammar observations for the complete answer. An empty array means that the answer key provides no direct grammar observation.

success_checks_by_answer_key.description: Map each answer_keys[].id to all grammar observations warranted by that complete accepted response. Its keys must match the answer key IDs exactly. Do not infer an observation only because a form appears in the sentence.

primary_grammar_target.description: The exercise's single primary grammar assessment target. Additional grammar observations may be recorded per answer key when independently supported.

fragments.description: Map each gap_id to exactly one word. The fragment keys must match the declared gaps exactly.

answer_word.description: One word for one gap; a multiword expression is represented by multiple gaps and fragments.

grammar_observation.description: One independently justified grammar observation from the complete response, such as pronoun choice, auxiliary selection, or participle agreement.
